messages:
alex: Quick sweep — can owners confirm status and any date shifts for the RCA action items below? Trying to close the loop before EOW.

alex: Actions (from INC-9876):
1) add graceful fallback for model routing — owner: tanya — due: 2026-03-22
2) fix cold-start KV-cache leak in runtime — owner: mike — due: 2026-03-24
3) update runbook + canary checklist — owner: leah — due: 2026-03-23
4) sync billing metric tags to trace logs — owner: carla — due: 2026-03-26

alex: If anyone needs more time, reply with new date and blocker. Please ack even if unchanged. @incident-bot, add a tracking row to the RCA board.

incident-bot: Automated: added INC-9876 actions to tracker (https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-9876). Reminder set for 2026-03-23.

tanya: acked. I have a draft PR but waiting on a small infra flag. new due: 2026-03-22 still okay. pinging @mike for kernel fallback integration note.

mike: ack. I hit a blocker with memory profiling — reproducer is flaky. Can shift my due to 2026-03-25 unless I get help today. @leah can you review the repro logs? short snippet in case it helps:
```
[2026-03-18T09:12:03Z] kv_cache_alloc: growth spike on seq_len 8192
heap: +120MB
```

leah: I can look now — quick heads-up: QA needs the canary checklist updated before we flip the routing change. I'll hold the checklist review until the KV fix PR is merged.

carla: ack on billing tags. I'll open a tiny PR: #PR-4582 and link to INC-9876. Tentative due 2026-03-26, but can move earlier if team wants.

tanya: @mike if you need extra eyes on the profile, I can pair for 30m after stand. Might speed up.

mike: thanks — that would help. Stand + pair after = sounds good. If we pair, I'll keep 2026-03-24 as the target.

alex: Updated plan:
- Mike + Tanya pair today -> aim 2026-03-24
- Leah to update checklist after PR merge -> aim 2026-03-23
- Carla PR stays 2026-03-26 but move up if infra stable.

alex: Small ask: please add the PR/ticket links in the tracker row so SRE and Eng-Platform can follow. If anyone's unassigned in Jira, tell me and I'll assign.

carla: added PR link and JIRA refs to the tracker row.

leah: quick QA note — checklist needs one more test for fallback correctness: "simulate region failover". I'll add it to the checklist item.

mike: pairing now with @tanya. I'll update INC-9876 with a short runbook step about the repro command.

tanya: acked + merging small infra flag once CI green. Will post PR link in the tracker.

alex: Perfect. If anything slips beyond 2026-03-26, call it out here so we can escalate to PMs. Thanks all :thumbsup
